newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu ends lower, markets awaits elections.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu ends lower, markets awaits elections.

text.p: Romania's leu closed on Friday easing down 10 units against the greenback to 3,410/25 on a quiet interbank market with traders awaiting Sunday's parliamentary and presidential elections.
Operators said trading remained gripped by squeezes with most dollar owners in a wait-and-see mood on the eve of the polls.

"Nothing has happened today. There were only few deals with clients and most in other currencies as prices have yet to reach a level which can lure dollar sellers," said one trader with a broker bank.
The leu weakened gradually by about 1.64 percent this week and trading kept a subdued note with overall volume at about $13.2 million daily on average in the first four days.
The focus of the market was in other currencies, used as a backdoor for trading for months. Their cross quotes yield weaker leu-dollar prices of between 3,700 to 3,900.
Most traders were reluctant to give a forecast for the leu's moves after the polls but said it was unlikely to witness a sudden slump against the dollar.
"I expect fresh lows for the leu but I doubt there will be many changes at once," another trader said.
Leu-dollar retail prices continued to be some 25 percent lower than the interbank rates.
Short-term rates stayed near 41 percent amid a money market flooded with leu funds. -- Mirela Eremia, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
